audit.whatIsWrong: All fourteen chart cells read 'Skill' where the packet chart and the mirror both give Ryze levels 1, first item and 2+ items, and Gangplank levels 3 and 4-5.
audit.why: A flat 'Skill' chart tells the player nothing and disagrees with the audited Gangplank side.
audit.corrected: Ryze / Skill / Gangplank / Gangplank / Skill / Ryze / Ryze, proposed as matched full+content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Seraph's at first item is the genuine inflection; level 6 is macro-only for both (Realm Warp is a group teleport, Cannon Barrage is global pressure without a duel change).
audit.corrected: Left as written apart from the true-damage addition in whys[4].

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0], early and spikes[0].text all claim Ryze must approach melee range at level 1.
audit.why: Overload is 1000 range against Parrrley's 625 — Ryze out-ranges him outright at level 1. That is why the packet gives him the level. Remove Scurvy (22/20/18/16/14s) cleanses Rune Prison, and Cannon Barrage deals true damage, so resistances are the wrong buy.
audit.corrected: State the 1000-vs-625 range edge, hold W until Remove Scurvy is spent, and buy Grievous Wounds rather than raw resistances.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned only in the item line, never where the player reads about extended trades.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy heals and cleanses; without Grievous Wounds an extended trade is refunded.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal moved into the barrel do-line.

audit.why: suspectNames flagged 'Use Remove Scurvy' as a wrong name — false positive, Remove Scurvy is his real W. 'Powder Kegs' in early is a pluralised form of Powder Keg and reads acceptably; the rewritten sentence uses the singular anyway.
audit.corrected: No name change needed beyond the rewrite.

edits.before: You have Q only and must approach melee range — he plants barrels at your CS positions and collects poke gold before you can threaten anything.
edits.after: Overload out-ranges Parrrley 1000 to 625 — poke him off the wave for free and simply never stand where a Powder Keg he planted can reach you.

edits.before: Cannon Barrage adds global pressure but does not change the 1v1 math — Realm Warp gives you a parallel macro threat and the lane settles into mutual respect.
edits.after: Cannon Barrage adds global pressure and true damage that stacked resistances cannot answer — Realm Warp is your parallel macro threat and the lane evens out.

edits.before: Your Q range barely reaches his barrels — he collects free poke gold off you while you can only auto or Q into his trap radius.
edits.after: Overload out-ranges Parrrley 1000 to 625 — poke freely, but a keg planted on your CS spot turns any step-in into a crit-slow.

edits.before: Barrel chains chunk half your HP — kill kegs on sight. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Barrel chains chunk half your HP — kill kegs on sight; anti-heal beats Remove Scurvy.

edits.before: Level 1 is his — you have only Q and must walk into melee range to trade while he places Powder Kegs at your CS positions and collects poke gold off your approach. Do not step into barrel-chain radius trying to land a Q; you will take a crit-slow and give him lane prio for nothing. Farm with Q at max range, bank Manaflow stacks, and accept that he wins the HP trade at level 1. At level 2 you gain W, which threatens a root punish if he plants a keg too close, but he can Remove Scurvy your root on a short cooldown — treat W as a threat to make him respect your space, not a guaranteed lock-down. By level 3 your full E-W-Q loop is available, but his barrel chain damage spikes at the same time; only commit to a full rotation when he has walked up to last-hit and his Q is on cooldown, giving you the window where he cannot detonate a barrel mid-trade.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours on range — Overload reaches 1000 units to Parrrley's 625, so poke him off the wave and take the HP trade for free. Do not step into barrel-chain radius chasing a last hit; that is the only way he wins level 1, and the crit-slow gives him prio for nothing. Farm at max range, bank Manaflow stacks, and make him be the one who walks forward. At level 2 you gain W, which threatens a root punish if he plants a keg too close, but Remove Scurvy cleanses that root on a 22-second cooldown at rank 1 — treat W as a threat that buys you space, not a guaranteed lock-down. By level 3 your full E-W-Q loop is available, but his barrel chain damage spikes at the same time; only commit to a full rotation when he has walked up to last-hit and his Q is on cooldown, giving you the window where he cannot detonate a barrel mid-trade.

edits.before: Q poke only — farm, respect everything, and bank Manaflow stacks. You're buying time, not fighting.
edits.after: Overload reaches 1000 to his 625 — poke off the wave, bank Manaflow, and stay out of keg radius.

notes: The 'must approach melee range' claim in whys[0]/spikes[0]/early was factually wrong — Overload is 1000 range against Parrrley's 625 — and it was the reason the level-1 cell disagreed with the packet. The 'early' paragraph was rewritten in place (length checked, -3%) so it no longer opens with 'Level 1 is his'.
